The first release of **Matita as a Mac app**: download, drag to Applications, open. No Terminal, Homebrew or Python needed.

**Download:** `Matita-3.20.0.dmg` below (Apple Silicon, macOS 14 or later).

The first time, macOS says it can't check the app for malware, because Matita isn't signed with a paid Apple Developer ID. Click **Done**, then **System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway**.

### What's inside
- Transcription on your Mac with whisper.cpp (Metal) or NVIDIA Parakeet
- Speaker names, AI summaries and title ideas (Ollama on your Mac, or Claude)
- iPhone Voice Memos, watch folders and call recording (macOS 14.2+)
- Obsidian notes, Word/Markdown/SRT export, ⌘K search

Already using the Terminal version? The app takes over on first launch. Your transcripts, settings and models carry over.
